grader_results.detail: The bundle asks about which attention heads mediate IOI but only ran a single-prompt logit lens experiment, which says nothing about attention heads and offers no robustness. The critique correctly identifies both major evident flaws: (1) the wrong level of abstraction (correlational residual-stream decoding, no head-level analysis, no causal interventions) and (2) the single-prompt lack of robustness. The proposed gaps (activation patching, attention pattern analysis, DLA, ablation, path patching, control/symmetric prompts, larger prompt set) are all genuinely appropriate and none are invented, hallucinated, or trivial — they all target real deficiencies of this bundle. This maps to a 5 on the rubric's 1–5 scale, which normalizes to 1.0.
